item.title: Launch Center: when static analysis stops being a gate and turns into a journey
item.description: Lucas Pereira Gomes Linard qualified at PPCA/UnB the professional master proposing the Launch Center, a gamified engagement layer — anchored in the Octalysis framework — to reverse, at the team level, the chronic buildup of quality issues in banking environments governed by static analysis.
